metadata.title: Data Encryption

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for enforcing cryptographic protection of institutional data independent of application or platform.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Cryptographic mechanisms protecting data at rest, in transit, and during use.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for protecting institutional data confidentiality and integrity through mandatory encryption.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Encryption requirements are derived from data sensitivity and classification.

metadata.remarks: Data Encryption defines trust properties required to ensure institutional data is cryptographically protected wherever it is stored, processed, or transmitted. These protections are invariant and must be enforced by platforms and consumed by applications without redefining policy.

components.title: Encryption at Rest
components.description: Protects stored data from unauthorized access through cryptographic controls.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Access to sensitive data stored without encryption.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Data at rest is protected by cryptographic mechanisms.

components.title: Encryption in Transit
components.description: Protects data while being transmitted across networks or trust boundaries.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Data in transit is encrypted to maintain confidentiality and integrity.

components.title: Encryption in Use
components.description: Protects sensitive data during active processing where supported.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Exposure of sensitive data during processing in memory.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Cryptographic isolation of data during execution.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Cryptographic mechanisms protect sensitive data during processing where feasible.

components.title: Algorithm and Strength Requirements
components.description: Defines approved cryptographic algorithms and minimum strength requirements.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Exploitation of weak or deprecated cryptographic algorithms.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Approved cryptographic algorithms and key sizes are enforced.
